note: High-desert state park in Joshua-tree woodland at the foot of Saddleback Butte, about 17 miles east of Lancaster in the Antelope Valley. The campground is off 170th Street East just north of Avenue K. Most sites have a shade ramada as a sun and wind block. The 2-mile Saddleback Butte Peak Trail starts in the campground, and the park is popular for stargazing. --Claude
summary: parks.ca.gov page (fees, campground facilities, rig limits, hours, restrictions) and ReserveCalifornia read. First-come only for the 37 family sites (RC lists just the group camp), so booking changes from reservable to not reservable / fcfs always. $20 (+$5 per extra vehicle, one vehicle plus trailer included); check or exact cash. Max 30 ft, many longer. Flush toilets, water, dump $10, no showers. Year-round, no restrictions. Pin fine. Not waterfront.
